purpose: Fail-closed interface for future dry-down/rewetting empirical evidence. Conformance to this schema is necessary but not sufficient for scientific admissibility.

conditional_mass_terms.M_soil_or_mineral_receiver_NH4_N: required whenever soil/mineral contact is possible
conditional_mass_terms.other_measured_N_terms: required for any additional known receiver or loss pathway

material_characterization_required.minimum: sufficient composition/phase evidence to state what retained residue was actually tested and to assess mapping to the ANIMO continuation state
material_characterization_required.unknown_or_unresolved_result: allowed but forces MATERIAL_MAPPING_INSUFFICIENT for Class-F unlock

mass_balance_required.identity: M_dry_retained_total_N = aqueous_rewet + soil_or_mineral_receiver + NH3_rewet + terminal_non_aqueous + other_measured_terms + residual
mass_balance_required.criterion: predeclared by executing study from analytical uncertainty and recovery performance

evidence_strength_rules: schema conformance is not physical validation
synthetic test cases are not empirical evidence
a single-condition pass cannot establish universal ANIMO applicability
negative and inconclusive runs must remain in the evidence package
material mapping and process discrimination are separate gates
